descriptionChirho: Qal: to pass on, pass through, or sweep by a place in physical movement
Qal: to pass away, vanish, cease to exist, or undergo change in the sense of transience
Qal: to pierce through or penetrate, as a weapon or sharp object passing through flesh
Qal: to violate or transgress a covenant or law, treating it as something passed over or disregarded
Piel/Hifil: to change, exchange, or replace one thing for another, such as garments or building materials
Hifil: to renew strength or youth, or of a plant sprouting new growth after being cut down
